- 01M0XGQGZVDZ9HQEB7V5M4GPYW: "Chose to append the memo errata (the plan's recommended option) with a fifth item"
- 01M21M2S3Q8FCQNQ050D0WBNEF: "Chose a lazily built claimant map (one get per index entry, only at retired dead-ends, ≤20 hidden rows) for the lineage reverse scan over projecting `supersedes` into DecisionIndexEntry this wave"
- 01M2YH9XS3YR0Z5752HTNMJR3Y: "Chose dev-scale batch 1 = all 21 development stages × 4 arms (84 sessions) plus floor/ceiling controls on C01 and C08, held-out only if batch 1 completes within the usage window"
- 01M2Z2ZAEG5H82H2BKE9A3R7S7: "SEED-DRY boots the 1.34.1 bundle with TWINING_DASHBOARD=0 and a symlinked copy of the harness's own .twining/models embedding cache"
